compiled_state.title: /dso:sprint worktree-isolation: dispatch batch with isolation:worktree -> harness reaps all agent worktrees pre-harvest, sub-agent work lost
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **Model ID:** claude-opus-4-8 (orchestrator)
* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso-dev 1.17.102; Claude Code harness 2.1.160
* **Active Configs:** dso.workflow=ci-pr; worktree isolation always enabled (ISOLATION_ENABLED=true); SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr; .sprint-active marker present
* **Context Scope:** session worktree /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260601-183103, branch worktree-20260601-183103
* **code_version:** 4ffb9550da38671c320465217651db5210c996b0

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

Per skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md and skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md: sub-agents dispatched with `isolation: "worktree"` each receive a persistent isolated git worktree on a `worktree-agent-<id>` branch. After each sub-agent returns, the orchestrator (Phase F) enters the worktree (`cd $WORKTREE_PATH`), records gates, commits in the worktree branch, and harvests it into the session branch via `harvest-worktree.sh` (or, in ci-pr mode, via a per-task PR `gh pr create --base $SESSION_BRANCH --head worktree-agent-<id>`). The worktree and branch MUST persist from sub-agent return until the orchestrator completes harvest.

#### Actual Behavior

During /dso:sprint waxen-sigma (epic 99f1-153c) Phase F, a 4-task Layer-0 batch was dispatched concurrently, each Agent call with `isolation: "worktree"`. All 4 agents returned success; each result block reported a distinct worktreePath under /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/.claude/worktrees/agent-<id> and a worktreeBranch worktree-agent-<id>:

* 315a-77fb-13c5-4f0e (general-purpose) -> agent-ae5f9707bdf547b37 / worktree-agent-ae5f9707bdf547b37
* 55c7-f127-ba0d-4b2a (dso:red-test-writer) -> agent-aeb945a7417308627 / worktree-agent-aeb945a7417308627
* 5e96-ea32-4238-4a3f (general-purpose) -> agent-a27daaff7938bddb9 / worktree-agent-a27daaff7938bddb9
* b5fd-7682-53e0-4c55 (dso:red-test-writer) -> agent-a599c4fb596ed12f2 / worktree-agent-a599c4fb596ed12f2

Immediately after the batch returned (before any orchestrator harvest), ALL of the following were observed in the session worktree:

1. `git worktree list` contains NONE of the 4 reported agent worktrees.
2. `git rev-parse --verify worktree-agent-<id>` fails (MISSING) for all 4 branches; `git branch -a | grep agent` shows only unrelated branches from prior sessions.
3. On disk, /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/.claude/worktrees/ contains only `agent-acd3f45aea43533c9` (an id that does NOT match any of the 4 returned agentIds); the 4 reported agent-<id> directories do not exist.
4. The 2 general-purpose agents' file changes (315a: plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md + .gitignore; 5e96: tests/fixtures/antipattern-chain/*.sh x4) appeared STAGED in the SESSION worktree working tree — the 315a agent's report explicitly stated it 'copied changes to the session worktree and staged them there'.
5. The 2 dso:red-test-writer agents' output files (tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh, tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh) are ABSENT everywhere — not in the session worktree, not in any surviving worktree dir, not recoverable from any branch. Both tests had returned TEST_RESULT:written and were confirmed RED before loss.

Net: 2 of 4 sub-agents' work survived only as an incidental side effect (copied into the session worktree); 2 of 4 sub-agents' work was permanently lost. No agent branch survived for the documented harvest path. This is the failure mode the per-worktree-review-commit.md 'Step 1a — 907d post-return existence check' is written to catch ('The Claude Code harness reaps isolation: "worktree" worktrees under certain conditions ... A reaped worktree fails subsequent cd operations with no such file or directory — silent data loss if not caught here.').

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Resumed /dso:sprint waxen-sigma (epic 99f1-153c in_progress); auto-resume detected 11 open tasks, NO_DRIFT, clean tree.
  * Phase C: pre-check returned MAX_AGENTS: unlimited, GIT_CLEAN: true. next-batch composed a 4-task Layer-0 batch (no file overlaps in conflict matrix).
  * Claimed all 4 tasks in_progress; synced from main (already up to date); pushed session branch; captured SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD.
  * Dispatched all 4 sub-agents in one message, each with isolation:worktree, injecting SESSION_BRANCH=worktree-20260601-183103 and SESSION_HEAD=4ffb9550..., per worktree-dispatch.md.
  * All 4 returned success (2x STATUS:pass CONFIDENT, 2x TEST_RESULT:written RED-confirmed).
  * Phase F harvest pre-check: observed the 4 reaped worktrees / missing branches / partial session-worktree contamination described above.
* **Raw Results:**
  * git worktree list | grep agent -> 'no agent worktrees in list'
  * for each of 4 worktree-agent-<id>: 'MISSING'
  * session `git status --short` -> staged SKILL.md, .gitignore, 4 fixtures, plus a stray .claude/scratch/waxen-sigma/implementation-plan:step4:plan-review-draft; the 2 RED test files absent.
* **Known Workarounds:** Partial. The prior session (CHECKPOINT:sprint-paused:SESSION_END on epic 99f1-153c) hit the same class of loss and paused. General-purpose agents that copy output into the session worktree survive reaping; agents that only `git add -A` inside their own isolated worktree (per task-execution.md Step 8b) do not. Non-isolated dispatch (no isolation:worktree) would write directly into the session worktree but then requires the DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 escape hatch to commit (check-session-merge-only.sh accepts only merge commits while .sprint-active is present). No clean, lossless autonomous harvest path was available.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** /dso:sprint Phase E (sub-agent launch) -> Phase F (per-worktree review/commit/harvest)
* **Skills Invoked:** /dso:sprint; Agent dispatch with subagent_type general-purpose and dso:red-test-writer under isolation:worktree

comments.body: Phase C/D — ADVANCED investigation converged (convergence_score=2, both lenses agree). ROOT_CAUSE: the git add -A worktree-retention signal lives only in task-execution.md Step 8b (general-purpose template); the named dso:red-test-writer agent (plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md), dispatched via red-task-escalation.md which does NOT inject task-execution.md (0 refs confirmed), has neither retention staging nor a no-commit invariant — and worktree-session-head-sync.sh's 'git reset --hard' leaves its tree clean — so its isolated worktree trips the harness reap heuristic and is reaped before Phase F harvest. The 907d check (per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 1a) is HALT-only (no recovery path confirmed). Incompletely-closed predecessor: archived bug 907d-7242-516d-49cc (same symptom; prescribed this fix as Option A but landed only the HALT defense). Hypotheses: H1 (red-test-writer.md lacks retention/no-commit) CONFIRMED via grep; H2 (dispatch omits task-execution.md) CONFIRMED; H3 (Step 8b retention is GP-only) CONFIRMED; reaping mechanism CONFIRMED by this session's observed incident (2 GP-staged agents survived, 2 red-test-writer clean worktrees reaped/lost). APPROVED FIX (auto, high-confidence/low-risk, no safeguard mod, no new capability): add a '## Worktree Retention (isolation mode)' section to red-test-writer.md instructing git add -A + git status --short before TEST_RESULT and NEVER git commit (mirrors task-execution.md Step 8b + the existing Session HEAD Sync structural pattern). RED test: structural-boundary assertion mirroring tests/agents/test-agents-have-session-head-sync.sh. Complexity MODERATE. testing_mode=RED. Defense-in-depth 907d recover-path deferred to follow-up; Phase G sweeps sibling file-writing agents.

Read-only agents (investigators, *-evaluator/classifier/decomposer, completion-verifier, planner, bot-psychologist) and non-isolated code-reviewers correctly excluded.
